posts.name: Timjobinroach
posts.cooked:
Advanced Baron Blade vs. Legacy, Guise, Wraith and Tachyon with a randomised start.

This will obviously vary from game to game, but the mint was a squeaker for me with Legacy on 5, Wraith on 6 (thanks to Guise's incap and a superfluous Suture Self play when I knew I had him on my power phase), and Guise and Tachyon out for the count.

A rocky start with no cards that could deal damage and two MDP's meant I was on the ropes early, but once I got Inspiring Presence out, plink damage meant I was able to take out Ivan. He had 15 cards in the trash when I flipped him though. 

Break a leg!

posts.name: Griff's Dad
posts.cooked:
Easy Mint. 14/21/20/21

This was a random start and I drew the jackpot.

I started with a Heroic Interception and two Hypersonic Assaults. Legacy’s first draw was Take Down. Guise got the Barbarian/Blatant Reference combination going on Round Three. Wraith had Razor’s Ordnance in her hand and drew the targeting computer with her first draw. Basically, it’s hard to get a better starting hand.

The only pain was having to chew through two platforms before I could hit the Baron, but the Raptors helped. I got hit with one River of Lava, but otherwise the environment actually helped more than it hurt.

I’d like to say it was skill, but when you get three rounds where he can’t hurt you and a fourth where he can’t draw cards, and at the same time you’ve got your heavy damage dealers already set up, it doesn’t require much skill.

posts.name: Gus_Smedstad
posts.cooked:
Fairly easy mint.

Yeah, my first thought was “this is the Retcon card,” with Guise elbowing his way into a starter setup. Complete with Wraith and Grappling Hook.

Lots and lots of damage boosts. Legacy had Inspiring Presence turn 1, and Guise played “I can do that to” and “Yeah, I’m that guy” frequently, giving everyone +3 to +4 damage most turns. Took out the Mobile Defense Platform on turn 1 with computer-targeted throwing knives, letting Wraith him him with the 2nd attack.

One combo I belatedly noticed, after it was too late, was that Total Beefcake would let Wraith make a 2nd attack on Blade with her throwing knives. Normally not a big deal, but she was doing a minimum of 6 damage per attack, and sometimes 8 or more.

Everyone did take a fair amount of damage since the front side is a serious race to take out Blade before Advanced difficulty can put 15 cards in his trash. I avoided taking out damaging cards like Powered Defense Turret because I felt I couldn’t afford any additional cards in his trash, beyond the mobile defense platforms that you must take out.

Mint.

Got the first MDP down to 1 HP in the first round, but Blade put out a second one on his second turn.  "Fortunately" a volcano also came out.  I used Heroic Interception to weather the volcano and let it wipe Blade's board.  A round of copied Inspiring Presence followed by Guise the Barbarian + Blatant Reference wore  Blade's first side down and then some.  Legacy was down to 10 HP but Smoke Bombs, Synaptic Interruption, and Lightspeed Barrage made the rest trivial.
